question: What compliance-relevant obligations does "this cover page" establish independently of the effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions set forth in Parts I–IV?

semantic_arguments.ambiguity: The span requires compliance with both the cover page and obligations set forth in Parts I–IV, but does not specify what enforceable content the cover page itself contributes versus content confined to the named parts.

notes: Purpose A must determine whether enforceable numeric discharge limits on the cover page are in scope. Purpose B must determine whether monitoring requirements on the cover page are in scope. Purpose C may depend on whether the cover page establishes conditions that affect how missing or non-numeric monitoring evidence should be interpreted.
